name: Litepod MCP
description: Reviews Litepod exec calls (start, stop, environment variables, domains, compose files or source, redeploy, roll back, delete, and deploys from a repository, ZIP or Compose file) only when the harness reports no endpoint and the server is named litepod. It does not cover connections that report a Litepod organization endpoint (/api/v1/organizations/<id>/mcp) or self-hosted Litepod; those stay on Guard's usual handling. Reads through get stay on Guard's usual handling. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use get to read projects, applications, deployments, logs and domains, which does not change anything.
Prefer exec proposals that Litepod asks a person to confirm over start and stop, which run immediately.
